post.description:
For the JGB yield curve on a date or a daily yield series over a date range. Omit both dates for the latest rows.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Carries the range, tenors and page size; the other inputs are ignored when it is given.

end_date.description: Latest date to include (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest published day. A range with no business days (a weekend or holiday) returns no rows. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

page_size.description:
Rows per page; next_cursor continues to older rows.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 250.

start_date.description: Earliest date to include (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound (data starts 1974-09-24). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

tenors.description: Tenors to return, e.g. ["2y", "10y", "30y"]. Omit for all 15.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Daily Japanese government bond (JGB) benchmark yields by tenor (1Y-10Y, 15Y, 20Y, 25Y, 30Y, 40Y), in percent, as published by the Ministry of Finance (国債金利情報), from 1974-09-24 to the latest business day. Rows are newest first. Reads the current-month CSV, and the full history CSV (about 1.2 MB) only when the range starts before the current month.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `rows` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string | Business day (Japan), ISO date. |
| `yields` | object | Yield per requested tenor. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Collect the whole list (default 100 rows per page, about 2,900 rows in the asset-freeze file) or one 区分 of it. For one row by 番号 use `records_get`; for a name use `search`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page. Carries the pinned publication, content hash, file, filters and offset; the other inputs are ignored when it is given.

entity_type.description:
Keep only 個人 (person) or 団体 (organization). Not applicable to the vessel file.

Provider reference: allowed values ["person", "organization"].

file.description:
asset_freeze = shisantouketsu{date}.csv (persons and organizations); vessels = ekimukisei_IMOnumber_{date}.csv (ships under the service-transaction restriction, identified by IMO number only).

Provider reference: allowed values ["asset_freeze", "vessels"]; default "asset_freeze".

kubun.description:
区分 (program number) to keep, e.g. 29 = ロシア連邦(個人). Unknown numbers return an empty page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 999.

page_size.description:
page_size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 100.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The full current list, one page at a time, with a cursor pinned to one publication (file date + body SHA-256). Every page re-reads list.html and the dated CSV; if the newest publication or the file's content hash moved since the cursor was issued the call fails with `invalid_input` carrying the issue code `publication_changed` instead of mixing versions (restart without a cursor). Filters: 区分 (`kubun`), `entity_type`, and `file` to read the vessel IMO-number list instead of the asset-freeze list.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addresses` | object[] |  |
| `birth_dates` | object[] |  |
| `birth_places` | object[] |  |
| `entity_type` | string | 個人 -> person, 団体 -> organization; every row of the IMO-number file is a vessel. |
| `identifiers` | object[] |  |
| `legal_basis` | object[] |  |
| `listed_on` | string | First date of リスト掲載日 when filled (634 of 2,900 rows), else the first 告示日付 date; null when neither parses. |
| `listed_on_text` | string | リスト掲載日 as published (with its amendment parenthetical), null when empty. |
| `measures` | string[] | asset_freeze for every row of the 資産凍結等対象者一覧; other for the vessel list (役務取引等の規制, a service-transaction restriction on the named ships). |
| `names` | object[] |  |
| `nationalities` | object[] |  |
| `positions` | object[] | 役職 (offices held), one entry per `;`-separated value. |
| `primary_name` | string | 氏名（英語）, falling back to 氏名（日本語）. Null only for vessel rows, which the source identifies by IMO number alone. |
| `programs` | object[] |  |
| `publication_id` | string | The YYYYMMDD date in the file name the row came from. |
| `raw` | object | The source row verbatim, keyed by the CSV header names (32 columns in the asset-freeze file, 5 in the IMO-number file). Empty cells are omitted. Kept open so a new upstream column passes through instead of failing the record. |
| `remarks` | string | その他の情報 as published. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the fetch. |
| `source_id` | string | The source's own 番号 (NNN-NNNNNN; the 3-digit prefix is the 区分 zero-padded). |
| `source_record_id` | string | Namespaced id: `jp-mof:<番号>` for the asset-freeze list, `jp-mof-imo:<番号>` for the vessel IMO-number list (its 番号 values collide with the main file). |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `titles` | object[] | 称号 (honorifics such as Mullah, Maulavi), one entry per `;`-separated value. |
| `un_reference` | string | 国連参照番号 (e.g. TAi.002), null for autonomous listings. |
